meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: Claude 会通过写小脚本操作浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表单、截图、抓取数据、测试网站,并且页面状态在多次脚本之间保持。
howto.when: 当你提到「打开某网址」「点击」「填写表单」等说法,或提出任何浏览器交互请求(如抓取数据、测试网站)时触发。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,告诉我标题和地址
say.note: 会新建一个名为 example 的页面并访问该地址

say.text: 截一张整页截图存到 tmp 目录
say.note: 保存 fullPage 截图到 tmp/ 下

say.text: 抓取这个列表页的数据,翻页时改用拦截请求重放

howto.what_en: Claude writes small scripts to drive a browser: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, test sites. Page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", or make any browser interaction request such as scraping or testing a site.

say_en.text: Go to https://example.com and tell me the title and URL
say_en.note: Creates a page named example and visits that URL

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot into the tmp folder
say_en.note: Saves a fullPage screenshot under tmp/

say_en.text: Scrape this listing page, replay paginated requests instead of scrolling
